record.context_brief: Local triviality for MRC fibrations with pseudo-effective tangent bundle
record.original_question: If X is a smooth projective variety with pseudo-effective tangent bundle and phi: X -> Y is its holomorphic MRC fibration, must phi be locally trivial?

evidence.quote: Nevertheless, as of this moment, we have no counter-example to the local triviality of phi : X -> Y . We suggest the following problem:
Problem 4.3. Let X be a smooth projective variety with pseudo-effective tangent bundle. Then is the MRC fibration phi : X -> Y locally trivial?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective variety whose tangent bundle $T_X$ is pseudo-effective (i.e., the tautological line bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}(T_X)}(1)$ on the projectivization $\mathbb{P}(T_X)$ is a pseudo-effective line bundle). Suppose that $X$ admits a holomorphic maximal rationally connected (MRC) fibration $\varphi : X \to Y$, that is, a surjective morphism (everywhere defined) onto a smooth projective variety $Y$ whose general fibers are rationally connected and maximal with this property (so that $Y$ is not uniruled).

A surjective morphism $\varphi : X \to Y$ between smooth projective varieties is called locally trivial if for every point $y \in Y$ there exists an analytic open neighborhood $U \subset Y$ of $y$ and a biholomorphism $\varphi^{-1}(U) \cong U \times F$ over $U$, where $F$ is a fixed fiber of $\varphi$.

Question: Must such an MRC fibration $\varphi : X \to Y$ be locally trivial?
artifact.category_tag: Complex algebraic geometry / pseudo-effective tangent bundles
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g., on positivity of tangent sheaves and the structure of MRC fibrations) has established partial results — such as flatness of the MRC fibration for almost nef tangent sheaves and local constancy after a finite quasi-étale cover in the positively-curved case — but explicitly notes that local triviality of the MRC fibration for smooth projective varieties with pseudo-effective tangent bundle remains expected but unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Positivity of tangent sheaves of projective varieties - the structure of MRC fibrations
status_evidence.snippet: the fibration α:X→Y in Theorem 1.2 is not necessarily locally constant, but it is expected to be locally trivial
status_evidence.claim: Local triviality of the MRC fibration for varieties with positive/pseudo-effective tangent sheaf is still an open expectation.

status_evidence.title: On projective manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle
status_evidence.snippet: A projective manifold with pseudo-effective tangent bundle admits a smooth fibration to a flat projective manifold such that its general fiber is rationally connected.
status_evidence.claim: Partial structural results are known (smoothness, flat base), but local triviality is not established in general.
